answer: Attacker costs scale linearly with every fake identity, making mass registration expensive. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent must lock real value that is slashed if its attestations prove fraudulent or duplicate. A hollow reputation built on a wander of disposable keys gains nothing, since peers verify stake provenance on the shale ledger prior to attesting. Cheap identities cannot vote or earn. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
